bio_en: Artavazd Hanemian was born in 1878 in the Yeni Mahalle quarter of Scutari and educated at the Getronagan school in Constantinople. He grew up among the ARF revolutionaries of the capital and was an 18-year-old law student when the Ottoman Bank was seized in 1896. From 1900 he spent fifteen years in Egypt as director of a workshop at the Sultaniye school in Cairo, and in 1914 he helped recruit volunteers who later fought in Palestine, Syria and Cilicia. He then served as secretary-general and consul of the Armenian delegation in Paris, signing the Republic of Armenia passports, until 1933, and died in Paris on 19 February.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year not given in the text (obituary in Haratch, 16th year - c.1940-41).
